name: Midori no Uroko
source:
The country of Mezbeh is home to the Mela religion. As a young child, the protagonist fled from a war-torn neighboring country, and now works as a maid in a Melanist monastery. One day, as usual, she is asked for advice by Ihason, a priest's apprentice....

[Translated from [url=https://booth.pm/en/items/4630144]Booth[/url]]
translation:
梅兹贝是一个信奉梅拉教的国家。主人公幼时逃离了饱受战火摧残的邻国，如今在梅拉教的修道院里担任女仆。一天，见习祭司伊哈松像往常一样，前来向她寻求建议……

[译自[url=https://booth.pm/en/items/4630144]Booth[/url]]
